name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention with no address residue. Accurately names a read-only accessor into the item effect table; the _entry suffix matches the sibling table accessors in table.c (fd2_get_spell_effect_entry, fd2_get_enemy_data_entry, etc.). The 'item' domain id 0..0xD6 (215 items) is a meaningful range, not address residue.
purpose: Leaf accessor returning a pointer to the type byte of item_effect_table[item_id], the start of that item's meaningful effect data; callers index subsequent fields off the returned pointer.
logic_summary: __cdecl, single stack arg item_id. Computes &data_fd2_battle_item_effect_table[item_id].bTY = 0x602AC + item_id*0x17 + 1 = 0x602AD + item_id*0x17. Disassembly: EAX=[EBP+8]; EAX*=0x17 (23-byte stride); EAX += 0x602AD; ret. No side effects, no globals written, cyclomatic complexity 1.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Item id 0..0xD6 (215 items); used directly as the index into the 23-byte-stride item effect table. Confirmed by caller fd2_check_job_can_equip_item which passes an item id and reads *ret as the item category byte.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects an item id index, no address residue, no rename needed.

returns.semantics: Pointer to item_effect_table[item_id].bTY (entry offset +1, address 0x602AD + item_id*0x17), i.e. the item type/category byte that begins the entry's meaningful fields. Callers dereference *ret for the type byte and read subsequent effect fields at ret+0x01..0x16 (offensive_flag, range_class, aoe_target_flag, aoe_shape, AP/HT/DP/EV deltas, etc.).

notes: Function name, parameter name, source comment (table.c lines 13-18) and Ghidra plate are all already correct and concise; no edits required. Ghidra struct item_entry has bUnknown_00 at +0 and bTY at +1, so the accessor returns &entry.bTY (the 'skips +0 prefix byte' wording in the source comment is accurate). The fd2-knowledge guide lists the entry's first byte as TY (type); that layout was recorded against a different FD2.EXE build whose table start differs, but it does not affect this accessor -- the function definitively returns the bTY (type/category) field, corroborated by caller fd2_check_job_can_equip_item. Plate's 'Callers (22)' is the distinct-function count; get_xrefs_to lists 23 call sites because fd2_compute_equipped_stats_with_item_preview calls twice -- consistent, no drift. Only this shard is staged because table.c needed no change.
